attributes.title: AACAP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.venue: New York Hilton Midtown and Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
attributes.summary:
The American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry holds its 2027 Annual Meeting from October 25 to 30 in Midtown Manhattan. Sessions are split between two neighboring hotels, the New York Hilton Midtown and the Sheraton New York Times Square.

At six days, it runs longer than most specialty meetings, so check which days you need before booking. AACAP had listed only the dates and hotels for 2027 when we checked. Look for fees, credit totals and the room block on the academy's meetings pages during 2027.
